about.registryInfo: Underlying: CMB International USD Money Market Fund (HK SFC-authorized, >$3.8B AUM, ranked #1 APAC money market fund by Bloomberg Oct 2025), managed by CMB International Asset Management (wholly-owned by China Merchants Bank). DigiFT (Singapore, MAS CMS licence + Recognised Market Operator) tokenizes an existing share class for accredited investors with instant on-chain subscription/redemption. BNB Chain/Solana/Arbitrum/Plume legs announced but addresses not publicly resolvable - Ethereum leg tracked only.
